name: Regex Tester
description: Test and debug regular expressions with real-time matching, explanation, and cheat sheet.
longDescription: Regex Tester helps developers write and debug regular expressions with confidence. Enter a pattern and test string to see matches highlighted in real-time. Get step-by-step explanation of each regex token. Built-in cheat sheet for quick reference. Supports JavaScript, Python, PCRE, and Go regex flavors.
pricingDetails: Completely free. All processing happens in your browser.
